facts.fact: 农场老宅 1894 年建成，是当地最早的宅子之一，由爸爸一侧传承。
Molly 霸占她的房间，两人被塞进书房的折叠床——「双人床」都是抬举。
facts.anchor: Double bed might be too generous

facts.fact: 鸡群以食物命名：Nugget、Schnitzel、Parma、Kyiv，Jake 与 Eden 的童年杰作。
facts.anchor: We have Nugget, Schnitzel, Parma, and Kyiv.

facts.fact: 修车玩笑时 Oliver 脱口而出：越了解你越爱你——Eden 当场宕机。
facts.anchor: The more I find out about you the more I love you!

facts.fact: 前男友黑历史：偷登她账号删光大学志愿，只想让她没有别的选项。
facts.anchor: he got into my account and removed all of them.

facts.fact: 野餐垫上 Eden 的护心宣言：你的价值不由他们定义。
facts.anchor: Your worth is more than anything that they could possibly tell you it is.

facts.fact: 他交底：妈妈是十年前的明天走的，所以他想忘掉复活节。
facts.anchor: She would have died ten years ago tomorrow

facts.fact: 亭中将吻之际，他低语双胞胎在偷看，完美时刻告吹。
